newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Sino adds Waterside flats at higher price.
newsitem.headline: Sino adds Waterside flats at higher price.

text.p: Sino Land Co Ltd said on Thursday it would offer an additional 70 units to the 140 flats already on offer at its Waterside residential development in Ma On Shan in Hong Kong's New Territories at a higher price.
The additional units will be offered at an average price of HK$6,523 a square foot, the company said.
The total number of flats put for sale on Saturday will be increased to 210, representing over 40 percent of the 502 units in the development, it said.
Sino Land said it had offered 140 flats for sale -- 35 at an average price of HK$6,000 per square foot and additional batches of 35 and 70 at a higher price.
The company said 345 potential buyers had registered to buy the initial 35 flats on offer at the close of registration on Wednesday.
The company said 85 percent of the units would be allocated to individuals and 15 percent would be made available to buyers registering in company names.
